steps.content: Night lights gleam softly against the marble floor. All around, sculptures and display cases hold their silent vigil, the air here thicker, more solemn than in the previous gallery.

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: Chief? Hey, can you hear me?
Your eyes are still scanning the area when Wynn's voice cuts in, right on cue.

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: Okay, you're in. This is the Eastside Museum of Humanities.

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: But heads up... their security system's way tighter than the last place.
A slight lift of your head triggers the transparent interface to snap open. A new floor plan and objective markers appear before you.

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: Just stick to what worked last time, and you'll do great!
You nod and steer the phantom thief's body carefully forward.
